span.normalized: We generally price and sell our solar modules on a per watt basis. During 2025, Silicon Ranch Corporation and NextEra Energy each accounted for 10% or more of our net sales, and the majority of our solar modules were sold to developers and operators of systems in the United States. Substantially all of our net sales during 2025 were denominated in U.S. dollars.
